rules.pattern: In this study, male Wistar rats weighing 190-210 grams were randomly divided into 8 groups
rules.replacement: Male Wistar rats (190-210 g) were allocated to 8 groups
Animals in group 1 (control) received no intervention

rules.pattern: Group 2 \(diabetic control\) received physiological serum for 2 weeks and then were induced with diabetes using streptozotocin, followed by an additional 6 weeks of physiological serum
rules.replacement: Group 2 (diabetic control) had a 2-week physiological serum period, streptozotocin diabetes induction, then 6 weeks of vehicle

rules.pattern: Groups 3 to 6 received physiological serum for 2 weeks, were induced with diabetes, and then treated with nettle extract, fenugreek extract, and a combination of both extracts, respectively, for 6 weeks
rules.replacement: Groups 3-6 shared the 2-week run-in and streptozotocin diabetes induction. Over 6 weeks they received nettle extract, fenugreek extract, or both extracts, respectively

rules.pattern: Group 7 received physiological serum for 2 weeks, were induced with diabetes, and then treated with glibenclamide for 6 weeks
rules.replacement: Group 7 had a 2-week run-in, streptozotocin diabetes induction, then glibenclamide for 6 weeks
